dataset.label: NIA Irrigation
dataset.scope: Six detailed irrigation sub-programs; agency-only CARP and broader agency appropriations are excluded.
dataset.house_note: House annex · 2nd-reading extraction, text verified identical in 3rd reading
dataset.caveat: Matching remains provisional. HGAB-only and NEP-only rows are unsupported insertion/deletion candidates, not confirmed edits. Changes do not establish transfers between projects.
dataset.matching: Two labeled methods share one ledger. strict: unique one-to-one candidates within the same sub-program by canonical title, no fuzzy matching. ai_corrected: additionally normalizes AI-monitoring matching keys only (verified NEP OCR readings Al/AL/AT→AI; Monitoring/Monitoring System equivalence); stored titles are never rewritten. Every row carries status (corrected) and strict_status. Unmatched rows carry deterministic variant marks (repeated_title, location_variant, exact_variant, spelling_variant, no_counterpart) — equal-amount review pointers that never create pairs or certify identity. Source-only rows are observations, not certified insertions or deletions.

subprogram.basis: Recorded comparison sub-program; repeated titles remain unmatched. One stable group per comparison row; changing grouping never rematches records or implies transfers.

program.basis: Recorded NEP program group, or House program group for unsupported insertions. One stable group per comparison row; changing grouping never rematches records or implies transfers.
